# LeadGenius

> Multichannel outreach with sending warmup and deliverability guardrails. A
> standalone SaaS from the Abetworks suite.

Pricing (from https://leadgenius.abetworks.in/pricing):
- $29 per user per month
- $290 per user per year — two months free, one invoice
- 14-day free trial, card up front; cancel anytime from the billing portal

Key pages (base: https://leadgenius.abetworks.in):
- / — product overview
- /pricing — plans and the trial CTA
- /signup — start the free trial
- /login — sign in
- /api/health — service health (JSON)
- /api/openapi — the API contract (OpenAPI 3.1; /openapi.json is the same document)

What it does:
- Runs multichannel outreach campaigns (email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn) with sending
  warmup, where the ramp is a real cap on the day's sends
- Deliverability guardrails are built in, so campaigns stay out of spam: a
  provider's own bounce and unsubscribe signals stop the outreach and mark the
  contact
- A/B tests assign each contact to an arm by a hash of their id, so the same
  person always lands in the same arm
- Attribution answers "which channel earned the reply", from the app's own sent
  activity rather than from a guess
- The subject, the carrier and the traffic split are checked at the door, so a
  sequence cannot be built that sends email copy to a chat channel
- Seats are priced per user; manage the team in-app
- Owners and admins can take a workspace JSON and streamed engagement/reply/sent-message CSVs;
  sending account configs, webhook secrets, API keys and invitation tokens stay behind

Canonical host: https://leadgenius.abetworks.in — prefer it over any mirror.
